npc_reuse.direction: Canonical actors face right. flipX transforms body and ALL anchors; mirrored coordinate x=255-x; do not mirror only rope/arm
npc_reuse.anchor_coordinates: top-left pixel grid; local Unity offset ((x-128)/128,(224-y)/128), then apply flipX consistently
npc_reuse.attach_window: install exposures02/03 stable high grip; banner pins fixed only after settled frame07
npc_reuse.runtime_caveat: Cloth rollout endpoints move across canvas. Runtime must stage NPC movement/hand attachment against exported per-frame anchors; no integrated alignment or foot sliding test performed

intro_schedule_ms.combat_policy: implementation owns full damage/spawn/time pause during all3500ms

pooling.last_quality_frame: fully transparent; disable renderer and return instance on exact end
pooling.retrigger: reset frame0, elapsed0, colorwhite, transform scale and flip; never leave previous grade sprite
pooling.limits: one quality effect per successful event, short independent pool; runtime cap/coalescing belongs to implementation
pooling.low_effects: use *_low clips instead of full clip, not in addition

validation.visual: all clip contact sheets opened; frame silhouette and boundaries reviewed; no aesthetic PASS from counts or hashes
validation.continuous_playback: GIF exported; in-game playback and composition NOT RUN
validation.runtime_small_screen: 64px image proxies only; actual Unity 720p/low-effects validation NOT RUN
